messages:
Maya Tran: quick heads-up — i'm out for a family thing tonight, primary shift was supposed to cover midnight-04:00 UTC (apac overlap). can someone deputize for the first half? i can hand off notes now.
Owen Li: i can take midnight-02:00 but need someone to cover 02:00-04:00 after my run.
Samir Patel: i can cover 02:00-04:00 if needed. on-call/standby laptop ready.
Maya Tran: awesome thanks @Owen @Samir — main risks: scheduled rolling deploy for inference-runtime lands at 01:15 UTC (can defer but infra prefers to run during low-traffic window). if we keep it, primary should watch canary metrics and error spike dashboards. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-deploy (useful snippet below).
Oncall Bot: :pager: PD alerting for inference-errors is enabled. escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> oncall-sre.
Maya Tran: runbook quick checklist (copy):
```
# inference runtime deploy watchlist
1) watch /dashboards/inference/latency and /dashboards/inference/errors
2) tail logs: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --since=10m
3) check canary instances: curl -sS http://canary-inference/health
4) if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback and page oncall-sre
5) if p99 latency > 800ms for 3m -> investigate batching/kv cache
```
Lia Chen: FYI prod traffic pattern shows a small spike 00:50-01:10 historically, which is why infra scheduled the deploy at 01:15. suggest keeping deploy but be ready to abort if errors > threshold.
Julian Park: tagging infra: @infra-team — if deploy must be deferred, please confirm window options.
Ops Bot: infra-team deploy job queued: job-id: dj-7783, scheduled 2026-01-13T01:15Z.
Owen Li: noted. i'll open the bridge at 00:50 and stay until 02:10. bridge link: https://zoom.internal/bridges/inf-watch-2187654321. i'll also run the smoke script every 5m.
Samir Patel: i'll join the bridge at 01:55 and take over at 02:00. will set a calendar handoff reminder 01:58.
Maya Tran: handoff notes: key endpoints to test: /v1/generate (short), /v1/chat (stream), embeddings sample: /v1/embeds. quick curl tests in runbook. creds for canary are in 1password: Team/Oncall/CanaryKey.
Owen Li: copying runbook checklist into bridge notes. quick question — if canary shows elevated errors but traffic stable, do we rollback or scale?
Samir Patel: decision tree: if errors correlate with deploy (error rate jumps from ~0.02% to >0.5%) -> rollback. if only latency increases and cpu on GPU nodes > 90% -> scale or switch canary variant (quantized variant).
Maya Tran: exactly. and file an incident ticket if rollback happens. incident template: https://internal.redwood/incidents/new (use severity guidance).
Oncall Bot: reminder: create incident if customer-impacting: >1% error rate OR sustained latency > p99 1s for 10m.
Julian Park: i'm available as a rapid backup if both of you need relief, just ping me.
Owen Li: getting bridge set up now, pasting smoke script I use:
```
for i in {1..12}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://canary-inference/v1/generate?prompt=hello; sleep 10; done
```
Lia Chen: i'll monitor dashboards and send a slack summary at +15m intervals while oncall team watches bridge.
Samir Patel: joining bridge at 01:55 as planned. noted escalation policy.
Maya Tran: thanks team — please react with :raising_hand: when you confirm the slot you take so others know. i'll leave my phone on for urgent pages.
Owen Li: :raising_hand: confirmed for 00:50-02:10 primary.
Samir Patel: :raising_hand: confirmed for 02:00-04:00 deputy.
Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Schedule updated: primary tonight Owen Li (00:50-02:10), secondary Samir Patel (02:00-04:00).
Maya Tran: perfect. final note — if you need to escalate to oncall-sre, mention rollout id dj-7783 and include canary logs link: https://logs.internal/q/filters?job=dj-7783.
Owen Li: copy. will post short postmortem if anything happens. otherwise i'll send a handed-off note at 02:05.
Samir Patel: will send final signoff at 04:05.
Julian Park: thanks all, enjoy the handoffs. :thumbsup:
Maya Tran: thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick cover. see you Monday.
